text: Welcome to the Pit! Blood on the sand, gold in the purse.
Fighter or spectator? Spectators stand back of the posts.
{player}! Come to test your arm?
Champion! The crowd chants your name when you walk past. Badly, but they chant it.
You've lasted three waves before. Ready to go further?
I can see from how you stand you know a blade. Good.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.
Happy {festival}, {player}! Everyone's in good spirits.
It's the {festival}. Half the town's drunk and the other half's working on it.
Five waves. Each one bigger than the last. Beat them all and you take the purse: twenty-five doubloons.
Nobody dies in my pit. If you go down, my lads drag you out. You keep a little for each wave you survived.
Leave the ring and you forfeit.
Chain your blows. Four in a row and the fourth one lands like a falling yard-arm.
Crouch for a heavy swing. Slower, but it knocks them off balance.
Paired blades keep a combo going longer. Hammers stagger anything. Pick your poison.
Bell's rung. Get in there!
